data: What is the value of the casual probability in the middle plot when the black line is at its peak?

From the analysis of the figure, the peak of the black line appears to be around 0.8 on the x-axis. Therefore, the value of the casual probability in the middle plot when the black line is at its peak is approximately 0.8.
